messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: surge in 5xx errors for /v1/generate (hosted). Error pattern indicates KV cache miss storm + batch fragmentation starting ~1923456740. Auto-escalating to oncall.

alice: I'm on it. Paging SRE. Any quick context on what changed?

dmitri: Noted. We pushed a small model-tooling change earlier that enables structured funcall responses (arrays of tool results) + prefetch for toolcall routes. Could be correlated.

carla: Looking at traces now — I'm seeing continuous-batching creating many small batches because toolcall responses contain large structured arrays that exceed prefix KV keys, causing KV cache eviction churn. Thundering-prefetch + large tokenized outputs -> cache blowup.

alice: Ok, list mitigations we can do in next 10m.

carla: 1) Disable prefetch on toolcall routes (temporary).
2) Shorten continuous_batch_max_tokens for affected pool to reduce fragmentation.
3) Add a quick rule: treat structured array outputs as non-cacheable until we patch kernel.

alice: Can we flip config via control plane? dmitri can you make the call?

dmitri: Yes. Pushing a feature-flag change to runtime-config service. Curl below:
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/runtime-config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","disable_prefetch":true,"continuous_batch_max_tokens":256}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-config/feature-flag-change by dmitri (rolling)

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: runtime-config/feature-flag-change (2026-03-15T15:12:30Z)

carla: Flag is live. I'm seeing prefetch counters drop. KV eviction rate down ~70% on the affected pool in the last 30s. Latency improving.

alice: Nice. Are we still seeing errors?

cs-liz: Customer-impact check: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, beta-fin) reported timeouts and 502s starting ~5m ago, support tickets opened. They're on Dedicated / Hosted hybrid.

ben: I'm taking secondary oncall. Will monitor dashboards + ensure throttles are stable. Recommend we also apply a short-term per-tenant throttle for aggressive toolcall routes to avoid repeat.

carla: Agreed. Also adding a runtime quick rule to mark any response with top-level JSON array >3 elements as non-cacheable:
```json
{"rule": "resp.size_array_gt_3 -> mark_non_cacheable"}
```
(temporary heuristic).

dmitri: Applied that rule to the gateway. Rolling through servers now.

deploy-bot: rule rollout succeeded: non_cacheable-array-heuristic by dmitri

carla: Metrics: error-rate down to baseline for most customers. A small tail of latency remains for very long structured outputs (we should throttle or stream).

alice: Good. Next actions (owners):
- carla: incident postmortem + root cause analysis (prefetch heuristics + KV eviction)
- dmitri: patch runtime to detect structured funcall outputs at tokenization time and skip prefetch for those (PR + canary).
- ben: monitor and coordinate customer comms with CS.
- eva: review product impact; decide if we need a change in structured output defaults.

eva: I'll schedule a quick sync with product + devex. This pattern could surface for some customer workloads if they enable funcall structured arrays by default.

cs-liz: I'll reply to the tickets: initial mitigation applied, we're monitoring, will follow up after RCA. Offer service credits if they request.

alice: Handoff: ben takes on-call for the next hour while I finish incident notes. If anything regresses ping me and @dmitri.

ben: Acknowledged. I'll keep eyes on SLOs and token costs. If we see any spike, escalate.

carla: Quick note for postmortem: suspected causal chain = toolcall structured array outputs -> prefetch attempted on full prefix -> large token footprints -> continuous batching fragmentation (many small batches) -> KV cache thrash & evictions -> higher backend latencies -> 5xx.

alice: Thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Follow-up items prioritized. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT mitigated: 1923456789 - root cause suspected, mitigations applied. Will keep thread open for RCA updates.

ben: Leaving a monitoring bookmark: watch query `kv_cache_evictions{pool=\"hosted-main\"}` and `continuous_batch_size.p50` for the next 6h.

carla: Starting the RCA doc now. I'll include reproducer and suggested long-term fixes: smarter prefetch (token-aware), treat structured funcall outputs as non-cacheable by default, canary config gating, per-tenant default limits for toolcall prefetch.

alice: End of handoff. Good job everyone. :hammer_and_wrench:
